about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I studied Software Engineering at Afeka Academic College, where I developed a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
My projects span AI/ML, computer vision, big data, mobile applications, and intelligent systems.
I enjoy solving technical problems that combine software engineering, data, and practical implementation, with an emphasis on systems that can operate in real-world environments.
